blind.description: A stylised, leaning wooden ladder constructed from two vertical side rails and eight round horizontal rungs passing through them. The wood has a warm light-to-medium brown painted texture with lighter highlights along the rung tops. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully continuous without shards, holes, or floating geometry. The ladder leans freely at an angle, resting directly on the ground at the bottom ends of the rails.
blind.from_above: Seen directly from above, it shows the two upright side rail tops and a foreshortened stack of eight horizontal rungs descending between them, with the ladder casting an extended ladder-shaped shadow onto the floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: Standing tilted, the top reaches roughly 6 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and its width is about 1.5 to 2 feet across.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
